findings.finding: The plan's scope pin `docs/llm-framework.md:407` points to the `#### Configuration error` section, which contains zero SC vocabulary. The actual LLM-agent processing protocol that names 'success criteria' as a distinct criterion type the completion-verifier reviewer scans for sits at line 435 (`verifying every completion requirement (acceptance/success/close criteria, definitions of done)`). AC1 grep catches the line 435 occurrence post-edit and forces a fix — but only if the executor runs the grep before declaring done; the scope pin creates a false sense that only line 407 is relevant.
